verdict.rationale: Zamzar has a documented REST API, so a machine-readable spec is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The Java SDK and code samples are developer building blocks, not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
